research.title: Delegates' Prize, ECR Net Zero Conference 2026

items.alt: Shagbaor on stage holding up a prize envelope in front of a screen reading Winners!
items.caption: Delegates' Prize at the ECR Net Zero Conference 2026, Birmingham, 9–10 March 2026 — for the poster *Electrochemical Industrial Symbiosis: Turning Carbon and Wastewater into Shared Value*.

items.alt: Nine people standing in front of a screen showing the ERGE Platform pitch slide at the Industry-Led Innovation Sprint 2026.
items.caption: First Prize at the Industry-Led Innovation Sprint 2026, for the ERGE Platform pitch — a £1,500 award.

items.alt: Seven people holding an oversized cheque that reads Startup Factory Scotland 2026, Second Place Winners, three thousand pounds.
items.caption: Second Place at the Startup Factory Scotland National Final, March 2026 — a £3,000 award for the ERGE Platform.
